name: BMW K1200LT
engine: 1171 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: BMW's big four-cylinder tourer. Heavy, comfortable, with servo ABS brakes and a lot of bodywork.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2005 K1200LTs are in recall 04V438 (anti-theft control unit can cut the fuel pump).
A-002.reason: BMW has had other recalls in these years too, so check the full VIN list.

add.title: Lube the drive splines
add.instructions: Pull the rear drive and clean and grease the shaft splines with a moly paste. Look for oil in the swingarm.
add.reason: Dry splines wear and fail. Most owners forget to grease them.

K: Early bikes have the servo-assisted integral ABS. Bleeding it takes the BMW procedure and sometimes a dealer tool.

recalls.what: Anti-theft control unit problem that affects the fuel pump.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects and replaces the anti-theft control unit free.

recallNote: BMW has issued several recalls across these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
